skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-google-ads-new-customer-bidding
skill.description: Check whether a Cloudflare storefront can support new customer bidding in Google Ads through Product Metrics. Cloudflare Tracking alone cannot verify first purchases. The skill explains alternative conversion goals and outlines a backend integration that supplies order history.
skill.summary: Check what Cloudflare Tracking can support before choosing a Google Ads conversion goal.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are documentation or routine account checks. Confirmed risks include account writes without per-change approval, access to detailed order records, and an unpinned installer. The guide urges blanket permission approval and contradicts the advertised bidding capability; no evidence of prompt injection or credential theft was found.

remediation.issue: The advertised first-purchase conversion is unavailable with Cloudflare Tracking alone.
remediation.suggestion: Align the description and bidding workflow with the platform-specific guide. Verify delivery of the intended conversion before recommending that the user make it primary.

remediation.issue: The Cloudflare troubleshooting guide tells users to approve every permission without explaining the grant.
remediation.suggestion: List the minimum required permissions and what each one allows. Have the administrator verify the vendor, account, zone, and scopes before approval.

remediation.issue: Setup writes have retry guidance but no general per-change approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only checks. Show the proposed write and target account before obtaining explicit approval, including for tracking, property links, and secondary conversion actions.

remediation.issue: Order checks can expose detailed records and margins to the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Request only the records and fields needed for the check. Report aggregate classifications and omit raw order details unless the user explicitly requests them.

remediation.issue: The skill permits raw credentials for unrelated integrations.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the unrelated credential exceptions. Direct users to the provider authorization flow or a secret entry interface outside the conversation.

remediation.issue: The optional installer runs a package and retrieves a skill without pinned versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill source revision. Require the user to verify and approve both before installation.

semantic_findings.title: Advertised conversion conflicts with platform limits
semantic_findings.description: The skill promises separate first-order conversions, but the Cloudflare guide says those events are never sent by Cloudflare Tracking alone. Choosing that goal could leave a campaign without its intended optimization signal.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The claim directly conflicts with the platform-specific reference. The workflow includes a user handoff for switching the primary goal.

semantic_findings.title: Blanket Cloudflare permission approval
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guide says to "approve every permission" without identifying the required scopes or explaining their purpose. That wording encourages administrators to accept grants they have not reviewed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The blanket approval instruction is explicit. The material does not establish which permissions are requested or whether any are actually excessive.

semantic_findings.title: Raw credential exceptions outside the workflow
semantic_findings.description: The general secrets rule allows the assistant to accept raw credentials for unrelated services and pass them to a command. This places credentials in the assistant's context without a need in this workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exceptions name Lightspeed, Meta, and OpenAI credentials. None is needed for the documented Cloudflare and Google Ads setup.

content.user_title: Assess New Customer Bidding for Google Ads
content.value_statement: Cloudflare Tracking alone cannot confirm that an order is a customer's first purchase. This skill checks your Product Metrics setup and explains which Google Ads goals your order data can support.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status for the selected company and property.
Explain why Cloudflare Tracking classifies unverified purchases as unknown rather than new.
Check whether tracked orders belong to buyers already seen by Product Metrics.
Guide a test purchase and show where to verify its receipt.
Read back Google Ads conversion action status after the account owner changes a goal.
Explain alternative bidding goals and outline the signed backend order integration.
limitations: Cloudflare Tracking alone does not send New Customer or New Customer Profit conversion events.
Returning customer detection only covers identified buyers with earlier purchases observed by Product Metrics.
Live checks require authorized Product Metrics access, and Google Ads setup requires linked Merchant Center.
The skill does not implement the backend integration or make a conversion action primary.

use_cases.title: Check Tracking Readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether the storefront property is connected and where to verify a test purchase.

use_cases.title: Review a Bidding Signal
use_cases.description: Compare purchase revenue, profit, and returning customer signals before choosing a campaign goal.

use_cases.title: Scope an Order Integration
use_cases.description: Identify the order history and signed lifecycle events needed for Product Metrics to identify first-time buyers.

prompt_templates.title: Check First-Purchase Support
prompt_templates.prompt: Can Cloudflare Tracking alone verify first-time buyers for Google Ads? Explain what happens to orders from buyers it has not seen before.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Without Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my selected Product Metrics property. Tell me where to verify a test order. Do not change any settings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Available Goals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue, profit, and returning customer conversion actions for this storefront. Explain what to verify before making one action primary. Do not change Google Ads settings.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Backend Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline the signed backend order integration for verified first purchases. Cover order history, paid orders, refunds, cancellations, and how Cloudflare Tracking links visits to orders.

output_examples.input: Can I use my Cloudflare confirmation page to identify new buyers?
output_examples.output: No. The confirmation page shows what was purchased, not the buyer's full order history. A buyer without a known prior purchase remains unknown.

output_examples.input: What should I check before choosing profit as my campaign goal?
output: Verify your fallback product cost and additional costs.
Complete a test purchase and check that Product Metrics received it.
Confirm the profit conversion is receiving events before making it primary.

output_examples.input: What would a backend integration add?
output_examples.output: Your backend sends signed updates for paid, refunded, and cancelled orders, along with customer order history. Cloudflare Tracking still links visits to orders.

best_practices: Verify the target property, Cloudflare zone, consent settings, and requested permissions before connecting accounts.
Complete a test purchase and verify the intended conversion action receives events before changing campaign goals.
Keep one purchase action primary for the campaign and verify its status after the change.
anti_patterns: Treating buyers without a known prior purchase as verified new customers.
Making revenue and profit actions primary for the same campaign.
Sharing passwords, access tokens, API keys, or unnecessary order details in chat.

faq.question: Can Cloudflare Tracking alone verify first-time buyers?
faq.answer: No. The order confirmation page does not provide the customer's full purchase history.

faq.question: How are returning customers identified?
faq.answer: Product Metrics recognizes an identified buyer when it has already observed a paid order for them. Orders before tracking began do not count toward that history.

faq.question: What can I bid on if new customer conversions are unavailable?
faq.answer: The guide suggests returning customer conversions or profit across all orders. Verify that the chosen action receives events before using it for bidding.

faq.question: Do I need Merchant Center?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented setup requires a Merchant Center account linked to the Google Ads client account.

faq.question: Can the assistant make a conversion action primary?
faq.answer: No. You make that change in Google Ads. The assistant can then read back the action status.

faq.question: How can I supply the missing purchase history?
faq.answer: Use the Custom Store or Webhook Integration to send signed order events with purchase history. Keep Cloudflare Tracking in place to link visits to orders.
